title: How Outrank went from $300 to $300k MRR: repositioning, backlink network effects, and owning the narrative
summary: Tibo explains how he and co-founder Eugene took Outrank from a $300 MRR AI blog generator to $300k MRR in 15 months. The keys were repositioning as SEO infrastructure, building a backlink exchange network as a moat, and flipping the "AI killed SEO" fear into a growth narrative.

principles.text: Positioning beats features: reframing the same product can change the whole outcome.
principles.quote: The lesson: Positioning beats features every time.

principles.text: A commodity (AI content) has no moat; network effects such as a contextual backlink exchange turn it into one.
principles.quote: The lesson: Network effects turn commodities into moats.

principles.text: Position into the market's fear rather than away from it; the winning narrative gets the customers.
principles.quote: The lesson: Position into the fear, not away from it.

principles.text: Different growth levers work at different stages: distribution early, product results and testimonials in the middle, narrative late.
principles.quote: What works at $10k MRR doesn't work at $200k MRR.

principles.text: Keep pricing stupid simple: one plan, no credits, no tiers, no confusion.
principles.quote: $99/month for 30 articles. No credits. No tiers. No confusion.

principles.text: The builder's playbook: find the moat, own the narrative, move fast.
principles.quote: Find the moat. Own the narrative. Move fast.
